actions: Wire the LB-015 Tauri command invoke handler through build_app without moving lifecycle ownership into the frontend
records.reason: LB-015 owns src-tauri/src/commands/** but the Tauri Builder that must register those commands is in src-tauri/src/lib.rs outside the normal LB-015 writable paths.

actions: Expose a UI-safe snapshot of the real owned runtime state/current task/outage

Route live permission change, workspace switch, manual retry, and runtime-only transactional cleanup through the same DesktopLifecycle-owned production orchestrator while preserving Tray Exit ordering
records.reason: The accepted LB-013 ProductionRuntimeOwner stores the real orchestrator behind ExitRuntime, which currently erases RuntimeState, CurrentTaskStatus and runtime control operations. LB-015 must render Rust truth and submit user intents without creating fake frontend state or a second runtime owner.
records.evidence_ref: Current src-tauri/src/app/background.rs ExitRuntime only exposes staged shutdown methods while RuntimeOrchestrator already owns state/current_task/active_outage/switch_workspace_to; LB-015 UI contract requires those truths and actions.

actions: Add a stable permission-mode mutation port to RuntimeDriver/RuntimeOrchestrator
Make ProductionRuntimeDriver update both the live PEP permission mode and its ProductionRuntimeConfig immediately
records.reason: LB-015 permission changes must become effective at the mandatory tools/call PEP immediately; persisting only the preference would leave a running runtime enforcing a stale mode and violate the cached-list security boundary.
records.evidence_ref: PolicyEnforcementRuntime already exposes set_permission_mode, but RuntimeOrchestrator/RuntimeDriver currently expose no stable application-layer port to reach it.
